newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Dumai changes use of part of IPO proceeds.
newsitem.headline: Dumai changes use of part of IPO proceeds.

text.p: Indonesian timber firm PT Surya Dumai Industri said on Wednesday it has decided to change the use of some 20 percent of its 78.7 billion rupiah proceeds from the company's initial public offering in June 1996.
The comapny said in an announcement that the amount, earlier earmarked for diversification, would be used to increase its stake in PT Perawang Lumber Industri, a subsidiary.

"The firm has decided to change the use of part of IPO proceeds, earlier earmarked for diversification into Medium Density Fibreboard (MDF) products, to be used to increase the stake in subsidiary PT Perawang Lumber Industri," Surya Dumai said.
Surya said the change of the use of the IPO proceeds would strengthen its performance and benefit shareholders.
The firm will hold a meeting on June 10 to obtain shareholder approval, Surya said.
Surya said during its initial public offering that 37 percent of its 78.7 billion rupiah proceeds would be used for investment in another subsidiary, PT Perawang Sukses Perkasa Industri.
Some 27 percent of the proceeds was earmarked for paying bank loans, 16 percent for working capital and the remaining 20 percent for diversification into MDF production.
Surya Dumai posted a net profit of 44.09 billion rupiah in 1996 against 28.0 billion rupiah in 1995.
